newsitem.title: SPAIN: BASKETBALL-SPAIN AND RUSSIA TAKE EUROPEAN QUARTER-FINAL PLACES.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-SPAIN AND RUSSIA TAKE EUROPEAN QUARTER-FINAL PLACES.

text.p: Spain and Russia each booked themselves places in the quarter-finals of the European basketball championship on Monday after scoring comfortable wins over Poland and Israel respectively.
Greece and Italy had already claimed their places on Sunday, while third-party results on Monday meant that Lithuania and Yugoslavia went through without even setting foot on court.
The results of first phase games are carried through to determine standings in each of the two second phase groups.
Hosts Spain recovered from Sunday's narrow defeat by Italy to crush Poland 104-61, while Russia outclassed Israel to run out easy 87-69 winners.
Italy beat Germany 67-62 to stretch their run of wins to five, leaving the 1993 winners badly adrift at the bottom of their second phase group.
France were also facing an early exit after going down 80-71 to Greece, who together with Italy are the only unbeaten side left in the competition.
